name: Add an empty-subject escape path to manual homework entry
description: The E2E-only manual homework entry screen leaves learners with no active Subjects on a disabled confirmation surface without an explicit empty state or recovery action.
acceptanceCriteria: When the active Subject list finishes loading empty, manual homework entry names the empty condition and provides a usable escape or Subject-creation path; confirmation remains disabled until a real active Subject is selected; focused coverage asserts this exact zero-active-Subject property and does not substitute a loading, inactive-Subject, or seeded-active-Subject case.
